description: This Java class 'ParameterListTableModel' extends AbstractTableModel to manage a table of parameters with functionalities such as adding, selecting, and clearing parameters, and interfacing with a DataRegistrationBroker to handle registration of LoggerData objects for logging.

classes.name: ParameterListTableModel
classes.description: A table model for displaying and managing a list of LoggerData parameters, supporting selection, data retrieval, and clearing functionalities.

methods.name: ParameterListTableModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the table model with a DataRegistrationBroker and data type columns.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of logger data parameters in the table.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the table.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified column.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Determines if a cell is editable based on its column index.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific row and column, reflecting selection status, name, and units.

methods.name: setValueAt
methods.description: Sets a value in the table, primarily toggling the selection status of a parameter.

methods.name: getColumnClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of data for a column, based on the first row.

methods.name: addParam
methods.description: Adds a new LoggerData parameter to the table and optionally selects it.

methods.name: selectParam
methods.description: Selects or deselects a LoggerData parameter in the table.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all data from the table and unregisters LoggerData objects from logging via the broker.

methods.name: getParameterRows
methods.description: Returns a list of all ParameterRow objects currently in the table.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Helper method to set the selection state of a ParameterRow and update registration with the broker.
